start: A gym open in HQ, card "Free trial and plan"

steps.action: Read the card
user_sees: "Free trial: started <date>, ends <date>."
"Nothing is locked when the free trial ends: members keep their app and the gym keeps its records."
must_not: A wrong end date

steps.action: Pick "New end of the free trial", type "Why", press "Save the new end"
user_sees: "Saved: the free trial now ends <date>."
must_not: A trial past 6 months from its start

steps.action: Pick "Plan", "Paid" (monthly, yearly or lifetime), "Paid until", "Why", press "Save the plan"
user_sees: "Saved: the plan is set."
"Plan: <plan>"
must_not: A paid-until date saved for lifetime

steps.action: Save with an empty "Why"
user_sees: "Write a reason (at least a few words)."
must_not: A change with no reason

steps.action: Pick a trial end past 6 months
user_sees: "That is longer than a free trial can be (6 months from its start). Pick an earlier date."
must_not: The longer trial saved

steps.action: Save a monthly plan with no "Paid until", or one over 3 years ahead
user_sees: "Pick the date the payment covers until." / "That date is too far ahead (3 years at most)."
must_not: The plan saved

steps.action: Pick no plan, press "Save the plan", confirm "Take the plan off this gym? It goes back to its free trial."
user_sees: "Saved: no plan (back on the free trial)."
must_not: The gym's records locked or deleted

steps.action: Open a gym whose trial is already at the cap
user_sees: "This free trial is already as long as it can be."
must_not: A pick list that offers a longer date

steps.action: The owner opens the admin app
user_sees: The new trial end or plan, and the change with its reason in the MettleUp access list
must_not: The reason or plan shown to members
